description: List people Odin suggests inviting to the team: people seen in the organisation's connected tools who are not members yet, each with the strongest reason and how sure Odin is, plus free seats. Only owners and admins see their email addresses. Inviting needs identity verification, so it stays on the Team page; a member can ask an admin with ask_admin_to_invite. Not available to every organisation yet, and refused until it is.
name: list_invite_suggestions
title: List teammates worth inviting
